text.description_html:
Don-Jo CFK7015-630, 3-1/2" x 15" Pull Plate with 6 Inch Handle and Deadbolt Cut-out

This 3-1/2" x 15" Brushed Stainless Steel Pull Plate with Hole comes with a 6" c.c. handle. It has a cylinder hole cut-out perfect for adding a lock. The 3-1/2" x 15" Push Plate with Hole is primarily used in commercial applications such as in restaurants, warehouses, factories, and stores. Made of .050" thick high quality solid stainless steel for longevity. Packaged with stainless mounting screws for easy installation.

Also available: Matching 3-1/2" x 15" Push Plate with Hole

This commercial pull plate is made in the USA by Don-Jo Manufacturing.

Specifications of Don-Jo CFK7015-630 Stainless Steel Pull Plate:

  • Plate Height: 15"
  • Plate Width: 3-1/2"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 3/4"
  • Pull Handle Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Pull Handle Clearance: 1-1/2"
  • Pull Handle Center to Center (CTC): 6"
  • Total Pull Length: 6-3/4"
  • Pull Handle is 4-1/2" from top and bottom of plate.
  • Hole Diameter: 2-1/8"
  • Hole is 1-3/4" on center from edge of plate.
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Packaged with mounting screws.
  • Don-Jo CFK7015-630 Dimensions (PDF)

*Sold Individually. Get a matching 3-1/2" x 15" Push Plate with Cut-out
